theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cdg_or_ball_graph_to_cylinder_graph
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (S : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → u 0 = 0 → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 r) → (∀ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) r, ‖fderiv ℝ u v‖ ≤ 1 / 4) → S ∩ ball z r = ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) r) ∩ ball z r → S ∩ {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 4), ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) (r / 4), x = z + ι v + ι' w} = (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) (r / 4)
